title: A minimizing current with density invariant along an (n−1)-plane has support in an n-plane (Simon 7.3.3(2), (8)–(10))
statement: Assume (CS): Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) be minimizing in ℝ^P (IsMinimizingIn S univ) with ∂S = 0, and let L ⊆ ℝ^P be a linear subspace with d := dim L < n. Assume the density function of S is invariant under the maps w ↦ y + λw (y ∈ L, λ > 0): whenever HasMassDensity S w θ, also HasMassDensity S (y + λw) θ. Then: (a) S is a cone (IsConeCurrent S); (b) S is invariant under translations by L: S(ω(· + v)) = S(ω), i.e. currentEval (blowUp S (−v) 1) ω = S ω, for v ∈ L and ω ∈ 𝒟^n(ℝ^P); (c) there is S₀ ∈ 𝒟_{n−d}(ℝ^P) which is minimizing in ℝ^P, has ∂S₀ = 0, is a cone, has spt S₀ ⊆ L^⊥, and satisfies, for all t ∈ L and y ∈ L^⊥: t + y ∈ spt S ⟺ y ∈ spt S₀, and HasMassDensity S (t + y) θ ⟺ HasMassDensity S₀ y θ for every θ ∈ ℝ. (For d ≥ 1, S = [[L]] × S₀.) Assume (ODC): Let P ∈ ℕ and let C ∈ 𝒟_1(ℝ^P) be minimizing in ℝ^P (IsMinimizingIn C univ) with ∂C = 0 and C a cone (IsConeCurrent C: η_{0,λ#}C = C for every λ > 0). Then there are e ∈ ℝ^P and m ∈ ℕ such that |e| = 1 whenever m > 0, spt C ⊆ ℝe = span{e}, and Θ^1(μ_C, y) = m (HasMassDensity C y m) for every y ∈ ℝe. (In fact C = m[[ℝe]] up to orientation, or C = 0 with m = 0.) Then for all P, n ∈ ℕ, every S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) and every linear subspace L ⊆ ℝ^P with n ≤ P and dim L + 1 = n: if S is minimizing in ℝ^P (IsMinimizingIn S univ), ∂S = 0 (BoundaryVanishes S), and HasMassDensity S w θ implies HasMassDensity S (y + λw) θ for all y ∈ L, λ > 0, w ∈ ℝ^P and θ ∈ ℝ, then there is an n-dimensional linear subspace Q ⊆ ℝ^P with spt S ⊆ Q.
lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (L : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), Module.finrank ℝ L < n → IsMinimizingIn S univ → BoundaryVanishes S → (∀ y ∈ L, ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ (w : Euclid P) (θ : ℝ), HasMassDensity S w θ → HasMassDensity S (y + lam • w) θ) → IsConeCurrent S ∧ (∀ v ∈ L, ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, currentEval (blowUp S (-v) 1 one_ne_zero) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) = S ω) ∧ ∃ S₀ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (n - Module.finrank ℝ L), IsMinimizingIn S₀ univ ∧ BoundaryVanishes S₀ ∧ IsConeCurrent S₀ ∧ S₀.support ⊆ (Lᗮ : Set (Euclid P)) ∧ (∀ t ∈ L, ∀ y ∈ Lᗮ, (t + y ∈ S.support ↔ y ∈ S₀.support)) ∧ ∀ t ∈ L, ∀ y ∈ Lᗮ, ∀ θ : ℝ, (HasMassDensity S (t + y) θ ↔ HasMassDensity S₀ y θ)) → (∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1), IsMinimizingIn C univ → BoundaryVanishes C → IsConeCurrent C → ∃ (e : Euclid P) (m : ℕ), (0 < m → ‖e‖ = 1) ∧ C.support ⊆ (Submodule.span ℝ {e} : Set (Euclid P)) ∧ ∀ y ∈ Submodule.span ℝ {e}, HasMassDensity C y m) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (L : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), n ≤ P → Module.finrank ℝ L + 1 = n → IsMinimizingIn S univ → BoundaryVanishes S → (∀ y ∈ L, ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ (w : Euclid P) (θ : ℝ), HasMassDensity S w θ → HasMassDensity S (y + lam • w) θ) → ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ Q = n ∧ S.support ⊆ (Q : Set (Euclid P))
